Yes, [Tri-anim Health Services](https://www.tri-anim.com/ths/) is a specialty healthcare distributor. Founded in 1975 and headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, it operates as a major national distributor focusing on respiratory, anesthesia, critical care, and neonatal care products and equipment for hospitals and health systems. [](https://www.tri-anim.com/ths/)

- **Core Role**: Specialty medical products distributor and clinical consultant.

- **Parent Company**: Part of the Sarnova family of companies.

- **Key Markets**: Acute-care settings, hospitals, and health systems.

- **Product Categories**: Respiratory care devices, anesthesia machinery, critical care tools, and neonatal equipment. [](https://www.tri-anim.com/ths/)
